sample.rule: Stratified random sample: up to perPathology patients for each of the 49 pathologies, drawn with numpy default_rng(seed) from the rows of that pathology, in file order.

inputRule: Only symptom evidences are used (is_antecedent = false). Antecedents (history and risk factors) are left out because MediSync takes symptoms.
Each evidence becomes one item of the 'symptoms' list sent to /api/ml/predict-disease, as the application sends a list of symptoms.
Binary evidence: the English question text (question_en), unchanged.
Categorical or multi-choice evidence: the English question text followed by the English meaning of each value present (value_meaning.en), joined by a space.
A value with no English meaning (for example a number on a 0 to 10 scale) adds nothing, so the question text is used alone.
Values whose English meaning is 'NA' are dropped.
correctness: A prediction is correct when the predicted profile name equals tier1_profile or one of tier2_profiles in ddxplus_label_mapping.json (case-insensitive, trimmed).
baselines: Random guess: for each row, a random ordering of one profile per covered pathology (seed + 1).
Majority class: always the most frequent pathologies of the sample (ties alphabetical).
Keyword overlap: rank all loaded Tier 1 and Tier 2 profiles by the number of distinct words shared with the input. No TF-IDF.
